corpora.source: Source-only SHA2 literal lengths and registered STRING/BINARY inputs; no expected values are read by capture.

cases.sql: SELECT sha2('abc', 0) AS text, sha2(X'616263', 0) AS binary, sha2('', 0) AS empty_text, sha2(X'', 0) AS empty_binary, sha2(CAST(NULL AS STRING), 0) AS null_text, sha2(CAST(NULL AS BINARY), 0) AS null_binary, sha2('café', 0) AS unicode_text, sha2(X'636166c3a9', 0) AS unicode_binary
SELECT id, sha2(s, 0) AS text_hash, sha2(b, 0) AS binary_hash FROM sha2_inputs ORDER BY id
